description: Part sourcing: external discovery, datasheet facts with checked quotes, supplier and lifecycle observations as dated evidence (never orders), alternates, and handoff into locally authored UHD parts.

skills.summary: Find candidate parts for a written requirement: look in the project and catalog first, then manufacturers, distributors and other markets in parallel lanes; record every lane, candidate and near-miss

Get a value out of a datasheet with proof: manufacturer revision on disk, parse once, extract for one ordering code with verbatim quotes and pages, then a deterministic quote check decides what may be cited
Record supplier offers (stock, MOQ, packaging, price breaks) as dated sourcing evidence and compare them at the needed quantity; reads offers, never places or prepares an order
Check lifecycle (active, NRND, LTB, EOL, obsolete) at the manufacturer, apply the selection disqualifiers, and name alternates with a form-fit-function comparison; near-misses are kept

Hand a sourced part to local UHD authoring (project-researched tier): parts/local and parts/evidence layout, which facts become UHD and which stay sourcing evidence, then uhd-part-author and uhd-part-verify
Independent audit of sourcing evidence: re-open offers and lifecycle sources, re-run the quote check, re-test the disqualifiers, and record what was confirmed, wrong or unverifiable

tools.purpose: Datasheet text layer for the deterministic quote check (datasheet-extract)
tools.install: poppler-utils (apt install poppler-utils, brew install poppler)

checks.summary: Sourcing records are dated and sourced, carry no orders or credentials, and state single-source, low-stock and lifecycle disqualifiers unless a named person accepted the risk
